_note: The devices a nurse would carry on the Gugulethu pilot, drawn in the MyThuso and GilbertOne look for the funder view (apps/web/src/features/PilotKit.tsx). Chosen from the Alibaba.com sourcing catalogue Gilbert shared on 13 October 2026; the catalogue numbers are its own. No prices here: what the pilot spends on devices is the budget's to say, in funder-brief.json, so this file cannot disagree with it.
status: Branding mockup. Nothing is ordered, and none of these devices is registered with SAHPRA for use in South Africa yet.
readingsNote: The readings on the screens are made up, to show where the MyThuso and GilbertOne marks sit. They are not anyone's results.

devices.name: Nurse handheld
devices.role: The nurse's MyThuso workspace: the day's visits, the visit code, and the handover to the doctor.

devices.name: Blood pressure monitor
devices.source: Bioland 4G, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth telehealth monitor
devices.role: Sends the reading to the visit record over Bluetooth, so the nurse does not retype it.

devices.name: Glucose meter
devices.role: For patients living with diabetes, read at the visit and kept on their record.

devices.name: Pulse oximeter
devices.source: Wellue Checkme O2 Max, CE marked
devices.role: Oxygen level and pulse at the visit, and overnight when a doctor asks for it.

devices.name: Patient SOS watch
devices.source: 4G GPS watch with an SOS button
devices.role: For older patients who live alone. The button reaches a person; it is not an ambulance.
